from dftracer.python import dftracer, dft_fn as DFTracerFn

_dft = DFTracerFn("app")


@_dft.log
def load_data(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        data = f.read()
    total = 0
    for row in data.splitlines():
        total += len(row)
    return total


def main():
    _dft_log = dftracer.initialize_log(logfile=None, data_dir=None, process_id=None)
    # dftracer app-parameter metadata
    _dft_log.log_metadata_event("path", "x")
    n = load_data("x")
    _dft_log.finalize()
    return n


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
